Cyclonic Storm “MONTHA” News, No.13, 2025

Wednesday, October 29, 2025 - 12:00

Cyclonic Storm “MONTHA” News, No.13, 2025

Issued at 12:00 hours M.S.T on 29-10-2025

Cyclonic Storm “MONTHA” Condition

According to the observations at 10:30 hrs MST today, the Severe Cyclonic Storm “MONTHA” has crossed Southern Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh Coast, India and moved North-Northwestwards downgraded into Cyclonic Storm “MONTHA” over the interior regions of Andhra Pradesh, India. It is likely continue to move North- Northwestwards and may cross interior regions of India and gradually weaken.

This is the last news for the Severe Cyclonic Storm “MONTHA”.
